talents.name: Twist of Light

ranks.description: When you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, gain an Echo. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.

talents.iconHint: Greyed square at bottom of vertical dependency chain; two maxed (3/3) talents above with gold connector line (37.png)
talents.diffNotes: Forever-only; Requires Level 40. Passive. No Classic name match.

talents.name: Deflection

ranks.description: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

talents.iconHint: Top of green hexagonal talent border visible under tooltip; icon art cropped out
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic foundation Deflection rank 1 (+1% Parry) and maxRank 5. Tree not labeled.

talents.name: Holy Conduit

ranks.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by 20%.

talents.iconHint: White/silver glowing blade or beam angled diagonally on bright blue-white; green border; rank 0 (24.png)
talents.diffNotes: Forever-only. Retribution tree title visible in 3.png/24.png. Rank 2 not shown.

talents.name: Improved Judgement

ranks.description: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement ability by 1 sec.

talents.iconHint: Golden judgement symbol / figure (greyed at rank 0); near top of Retribution panel with points counter 0 above
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic foundation rank 1 (Judgement ability, −1 sec). Retribution tab visible. Absolute row/col not reliable from crop.

talents.name: Conviction

ranks.description: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 1%.

talents.iconHint: Three white/grey swirling crescent energy shapes on pale blue/dark; green or gold border depending on shot
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic foundation rank 1 (melee attacks, +1%). Retribution (...ribution / ...ution) visible.

talents.name: Seal of Command

ranks.description:
Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 68 to 73 Holy damage, 137 to 146 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

talents.iconHint: Sharp silver sword blade pointing up with bright light-blue/white glow; Retribution header and partial top-of-tree grid visible
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic foundation Seal of Command effect and judgement clause. 65 Mana Instant from Forever tooltip. Partial Retribution grid shown but Forever layout differs from Classic — row/col left null pending overview.

talents.name: Sanctified Judgement

ranks.description: Gives your Judgement ability a 33% chance to return 20% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.
Gives your Judgement ability a 100% chance to return 60% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.

talents.iconHint: Silver/white sword angled diagonally on dark blue/grey; green border at rank 0 (7); humanoid-silhouette neighbor below
talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic 1.12 Paladin tree. Rank 2 not shown (rank 0→1 preview and rank 3/3 captured).

talents.name: Vindication

ranks.description: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by 42, and increase your Attack Power by 1% for 30 sec.

talents.iconHint: Golden/yellow stylized figure with raised arm on dark (clearest in 26.png); green border; sits above a four-icon row
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic foundation rank 1 text. Foundation ranks 2–3 still use Strength/Agility reduction wording — Forever ranks 2–3 not shown.

talents.name: Eye for an Eye

ranks.description: All critical strikes against you cause 5% of the damage taken to the attacker as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.
All critical strikes against you cause 10% of the damage taken to the attacker as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

talents.iconHint: Mostly covered by tooltip; neighboring column shows orange, golden plate, and silver mace icons (29.png)
talents.diffNotes: Forever rank 2 is all critical strikes at 10%. Classic foundation rank 2 is spell criticals only at 30%. Rank 1 text matches Classic.

talents.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization

ranks.description: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 3%.
Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 9%.

talents.iconHint: Dark silhouette holding upright two-handed weapon (10.png); gold border at rank 3/3 (32.png)
talents.diffNotes: Forever rank 3 is 9% (implies 3/6/9). Classic foundation is 3/4/6. Rank 1 text matches Classic.

talents.name: Vengeance

ranks.description: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 1% for 30 sec after landing a critical strike. Stacks up to 5 times.

talents.iconHint: Mailed fist / gauntlet with white-blue energy (33.png clearer); dependency arrow from talent above at rank 3; green border
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic foundation rank 1 and maxRank 3. Foundation ranks 2–3 still use older non-stacking 8-sec wording — Forever ranks 2–3 not shown.

talents.name: Champion of the Light

ranks.description: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 33% of your Intellect.

talents.iconHint: Figure in white/light-blue radiating light (35.png); dependency arrow from talent above; hammer-silhouette neighbor right/below
talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic 1.12 Paladin tree. Prerequisite arrow from talent above.

talents.name: Pursuit of Justice

ranks.description: Increases movement speed and mounted movement speed by 8%. This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

talents.iconHint: Glowing white/blue hand reaching upward (clearest in 28.png); green border; empty slot directly below in 28
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic foundation rank 1 (8%).

talents.name: Crusade

ranks.description: Increases all damage dealt by 1%. Increased by an additional 1% against Demon and Undead targets.

talents.iconHint: Yellow/gold icon below a blue-white upward-hand neighbor at rank 2 (31.png); vertical stack
talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic 1.12 Paladin tree. Rank 2 not shown.

talents.name: Instrument of Law

ranks.description: Reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 0.5 sec, and reduces all threat you generate by 10% while Righteous Fury is not active.

talents.iconHint: Silhouette holding hammer aloft on bright orange/yellow sunburst (36.png); green border rank 0; in a vertical column
talents.diffNotes: Forever-only; not in Classic 1.12. Rank 2 not shown.

talents.name: Redoubt

ranks.description: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 6%. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.

talents.iconHint: Silver armored gauntlet/hand; green border; vertical dependency line downward; Protection (...tection) header above
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic foundation rank 1. Protection tab visible. Foundation ranks 2–5 still use after-critical-strike wording — Forever ranks 2–5 not shown.

talents.name: Anticipation

ranks.description: Increases your Defense Skill by 4.

talents.iconHint: Partial metallic gauntlet/fist under tooltip anchor
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic foundation rank 1 (+4 Defense Skill).

talents.name: Sacred Duty

ranks.description: Increases your total Stamina by 2% and reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark spells by 30 sec.

talents.iconHint: Dark desaturated humanoid head/shoulders silhouette under cursor
talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic 1.12; mentions Templar's Bulwark. Tree not labeled. Rank 2 not shown.

talents.name: Improved Holy Strike

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 1 sec.

talents.iconHint: Golden mace/hammer head on bright field; green border; leftmost of three green-border icons (purple fist and eye neighbors)
talents.diffNotes: Forever-only; Holy Strike is not a Classic Paladin ability. Rank 2 not shown.

talents.name: Improved Seal of Fury

ranks.description: When Seal of Fury's shield is fully absorbed, restore 38 Mana, increased by 15% per level the attacker is above you, up to 45%.

talents.iconHint: Silver armored gauntlet/hand reaching upward; second from left in a four-icon row with connector from above
talents.diffNotes: Forever-only; Seal of Fury not in Classic 1.12 talent data. No tree label in crop.

talents.name: Templar's Bulwark

ranks.description: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

talents.iconHint: Grey/metallic shield with two feathered wings; bottom of left column; crossed-swords neighbor right
talents.diffNotes: Forever-only active talent. 110 Mana, Instant, 5 min cooldown from tooltip.

talents.name: Holy Shield

ranks.description: Increases chance to block by 20% for 10 sec, and deals 110 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

talents.iconHint: Shield with glowing center; middle of vertical dependency column (crossed swords above, heart/fist below)
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic foundation effect text (20% block / 110 Holy). Requires Shields in red. Forever tooltip also shows 150 Mana, Instant, 10 sec cooldown.

talents.name: Benediction

ranks.description: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by 2%.

talents.iconHint: Three white swirling curved shapes (triskelion) on dark; green circular border; Retribution (...ution) visible left
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic foundation rank 1. Retribution label visible. Foundation ranks 2–5 still say Judgement/Seal mana only — Forever ranks 2–5 not shown.

talents.name: Sacred Arbiter

ranks.description: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 10% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

talents.iconHint: Stylized golden glowing hand/gauntlet; green border; bottom of vertical column under rank-1 and rank-5 icons above
talents.diffNotes: Forever-only; ties to Holy Strike. Yellow silhouette neighbor to the right.

talents.name: Repentance

ranks.description: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

talents.iconHint: Golden winged figure on dark red; second in a four-icon vertical column (sword 5 above; gold 1 and blue 0 below)
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic foundation effect text. Forever tooltip adds 60 Mana, 20 yd, Instant, 1 min cooldown.
